problem: An unexpected virtual-audio transport exit could leave the gateway serving HTTP without its managed recording device. The existing process supervisor could not recover a process that had not exited.
change: The existing transport thread sends a one-shot termination event. The gateway uses its existing bounded HTTP drain and owned-device cleanup, preserves the transport failure as a nonzero process exit, and delegates restart to the existing supervisor. No polling thread, audio default change, driver reinstall or new service is introduced.
